summary: Comprehensive testing of the 4 user-requested features. Backend smoke (auth/me, shipments, workbook/tabs) all 200. Frontend P0 results: (1) /promo now serves a real local /promo.mp4 (HEAD content-type=video/mp4, 808 KB) and the page renders the HTML5 <video data-testid=promo-video> tag; the YouTube iframe is NOT rendered — pass. (2) Dashboard SortableTiles: all 12 expected tile testids present, reset-tile-layout present, old customs-broker-widget removed from Dashboard, localStorage-driven tile order works (verified by writing tms-dashboard-tile-order with map first and confirming DOM order). HTML5 dispatchEvent DnD also updated localStorage to ['video','map',...]. (3) YouTubeVideoTile: default src is mTxE3g7o4aY, typing https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ + Load updates iframe src to dQw4w9WgXcQ and persists localStorage tms-dashboard-video=dQw4w9WgXcQ. (4) /trade-compliance broker section: tc-broker, broker-contact, broker-portal-link (UPS SCS) all present; Account #, POA, Bond, Phone, Email labels all rendered; all 11 Incoterms still rendered. (5) /shipments: all col-header-*, col-drag-*, col-resize-* testids present (14 of each); LS-driven column reorder confirmed working (forced 'carrier' to index 0 in tennant_shipments_cols_v1, page reloaded with carrier as first <th>). (6) /workbook OUTBOUND TL tab: 12 wb-col-header-* and 12 wb-col-drag-* testids present; LS-driven reorder via tennant_workbook_col_order_v1 confirmed working (reversed columns persisted across reload); reset-workbook-cols button appeared after reorder and restored original order on click. All 4 P0 features verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: SortableTiles.jsx (114 lines), YouTubeVideoTile.jsx (128 lines), Dashboard.jsx (430 lines) are all well under the 700-line guideline.
YouTubeVideoTile.parseYouTubeId is robust — covers /watch?v=, youtu.be, /embed/, /shorts/, /v/, /live/, and bare 11-char IDs; bad input shows a localized error and does not clobber state. Good.
SortableTiles merge logic correctly handles legacy saved orders that contain unknown ids and tiles added after the save (appended at the end). Good.
Shipments.jsx column reorder persists the whole column descriptor array (id, visible, width) in localStorage — keeps width and visibility intact across reorder. Good.
Workbook.jsx scopes the reorder per tab_id under tennant_workbook_col_order_v1, so reordering 'Outbound TL' does not affect 'Outbound LTL'. Good.
Iframe allow attribute includes 'web-share' which Chrome flags as 'Unrecognized feature' (harmless console warning). Optional: drop it from the allow list to silence the warning.
Leaflet MapContainer occasionally throws a non-fatal React error (caught) on hot-reload of the Dashboard; not regression-blocking but recommend wrapping MapTile in an ErrorBoundary.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on functional verification (4/4 P0 features + P1 regressions)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 user-requested fixes are verified working on the preview URL. Note: synthetic HTML5 DnD via page.evaluate(dispatchEvent(new DragEvent(..., dataTransfer))) is unreliable for verifying React DnD handlers — the DataTransfer payload does not consistently round-trip through setData/getData. Use the localStorage path instead (write the order, reload, verify DOM) — this directly validates the persistence + render pipeline that the DnD handlers feed. tms-dashboard-tile-order, tennant_shipments_cols_v1, tennant_workbook_col_order_v1, tms-dashboard-video are the four LS keys. promo.mp4 is served via Cloudflare with cache-control: no-store; force-refresh is not needed.
